follow-up time: Duration of pregnancy (until delivery or termination)
exposure: Women who had planned cesarean sections
presence of Venous Thrombo-Embolism (VTE) risk factors
Women who had unplanned cesarean sections
outcome: Dispensation rates of Elastic Venous Compression Devices (EVCDs) during pregnancy and postpartum
finding: Despite recommendations for EVCD use during pregnancy and after delivery, observed dispensation rates were low, highlighting a discrepancy between guidelines and real-world practice.
mod_finding: EVCD dispensation rates were 17.3% after vaginal delivery, 46.7% after planned cesarean sections, and 44.1% after unplanned cesarean sections.
